name: Project: Swerve
desc:
🚗 | PROJECT: SWERVE
Speed through New York's busy streets, cut up in traffic, and compete with friends in this high-energy racing adventure! Unlock a variety of awesome cars and race your way to victory!

🔔 | LATEST UPDATE
New revamped Car Spawner UI
New car: Mercury E63 AMG
New car: Vankswag Golf R Mk7
New code for free EXP & cash!

❓ | Contributors
"chedsapp" for the First Person Driver Animations

❗ | IMPORTANT | ❗
If you are a car manufacturer and you think some vehicles in "Project: Swerve" infringe intellectual property rights, PLEASE contact me through the Roblox platform or through my DS Server.
Thank you.

(This game used to be called "Project: No Hesi")

TAGS: Traffic, Racing, Highway, Vehicle, Car, First Person, Drift, Drive, Driving, Realistic, No Hesi, Assetto Corsa, Shutoko, Project No Hesi, Project Swerve
